create_fbgemm_backend_config: create the FBGEMM backend config for PyTorch quantization by calling get_fbgemm_backend_config
build_conv_quantization_config: build convolution operator quantization config with quint8 input and weight dtypes for FBGEMM
build_linear_quantization_config: build linear operator quantization config with quint8 and float16 dynamic int8 dtypes for FBGEMM
build_embedding_quantization_config: build embedding operator quantization config with weight-only quint8 and quint4x2 dtypes for FBGEMM
build_rnn_quantization_config: build RNN operator quantization config with dynamic int8 and float16 dtypes for FBGEMM
